Fixture

While the font loads, this text is set in a fallback half as wide again as Fraunces, so every line holds fewer words and the paragraph runs several lines longer than it will once the swap happens.

Each paragraph under it starts lower on the page than it should, by the extra lines of everything above it, and jumps up when Fraunces arrives.

The jump grows with each paragraph, so a page of text like this one moves far more than the budget allows.

That is the defect the check exists to catch.
